actions.label: Wait without making it anyone's problem
actions.feedback: You wait. This is considered a complete activity.

actions.label: Study the ticket display very carefully
Ask whether this is the correct queue
actions.feedback: You speak to a stranger. Both of you survive.

actions.label: Offer a discreet €3 queue arrangement
actions.feedback: Three euros change hands. Nobody calls it a bribe.

actions.label: Drink emergency thermos coffee
actions.feedback: It is strong, lukewarm, and medicinal.

actions.label: Say "no niin" and commit to whatever happens
actions.feedback: "No niin" can mean almost anything. Here it means forward.

achievements.name: Actual Sisu
achievements.description: Complete a queue with 20 Sisu or less.

achievements.name: Pleasantly Distant
achievements.description: Complete a queue with social discomfort at 10 or less.

achievements.name: Eight Small Victories
achievements.description: Survive every queue and receive something technically useful.

scenarios.title: The Kela Service Centre
scenarios.intro: You need one benefits decision and have brought seventeen pages. Aino at reception gives you ticket B-143. The display shows B-119. Nobody reacts.
scenarios.completion: B-143 appears. Your documents are accepted for further consideration.
scenarios.transition: Carry the stamped uncertainty to Posti

events.message: B-143 flashes. You stand. It is B-143 for desks 8–11, while you require desk 12. You sit down with dignity.
Jukka has the wrong attachment. His departure advances everyone and changes nothing.
A printer performs a long private meditation.
The room achieves total silence. Your discomfort falls to culturally sustainable levels.

scenarios.title: The Posti Parcel Counter
scenarios.intro: A text says your parcel is ready. The yellow locker says it is at the counter. The counter says take a number.
scenarios.completion: The parcel is handed over. It is much larger than the thing you ordered.
scenarios.transition: Balance the parcel on the way to the health centre

events.message: Your number appears above the parcel lockers. Those numbers are locker temperatures. Nobody explains this.
Sari collects six online returns in one transaction. The scanner develops opinions.
A man produces a perfectly folded paper receipt. Staff visibly respect him.
The parcel machine says 'Kiitos'—thank you—to nobody in particular.

scenarios.title: The Terveysasema Waiting Room
scenarios.intro: You checked in online, at the kiosk, and with a nurse. Mika says this is correct. There are still five people ahead of you.
scenarios.completion: Your name is called. The appointment lasts four efficient minutes.
scenarios.transition: Take your advice to the Prisma checkout

events.message: A nurse calls your first name. Three people stand. She meant the other one.
An elderly woman offers you the seat you were offering her. Negotiations end in a draw.
Two patients are called at once. Finnish healthcare briefly resembles velocity.
The wall clock ticks with clinical confidence.

scenarios.title: The Prisma Checkout
scenarios.intro: You have rye bread, oat milk, and a bucket you do not remember choosing. Every checkout looks equally plausible.

terms.explanation: Finnish rye bread; dense, sour, and structurally reliable.

scenarios.completion: The cashier scans the bucket without comment. It is on sale.
scenarios.transition: Bring the bucket to the bus station

events.message: A new checkout opens. You arrive first. It is card-only and the terminal is rebooting.
A family ahead has separated its groceries with the tiny divider. Civilization persists.
The person ahead remembers the loyalty app at the exact final second.
Checkout four opens. Half your queue migrates with silent precision.

scenarios.title: The Matkahuolto Bus Platform
scenarios.intro: Wet snow arrives sideways. The timetable says the coach is here. The platform contains only you, Leena, and determined uncertainty.

terms.explanation: wet sleet that has found your collar.

scenarios.completion: The correct coach arrives. The driver nods once, which counts as a welcome.
scenarios.transition: Travel south for the Midsummer provisions

events.message: A coach marked Helsinki arrives. Everyone boards. It is the replacement coach to Joensuu. Everyone unboards.
Leena quietly confirms the platform number. This shared speech is now a friendship.
The delayed bus becomes less delayed without becoming nearer.
Two passengers choose the train instead. They leave without optimism.

scenarios.title: Alko Before Juhannus
scenarios.intro: It is the afternoon before Midsummer. You require one bottle for the cottage. Finland appears to require all the others.

terms.explanation: Midsummer, traditionally observed near a lake and away from email.

scenarios.completion: Your bottle is bagged. The cashier wishes you a good Juhannus with professional foresight.

events.message: The queue reaches the door. Outside is another, older queue. It has seniority.
Pekka chooses wine by reading every shelf label. Thoroughness is free.
A second till opens. Nobody runs. Everyone moves extremely purposefully.
Someone says 'moi' to an acquaintance and then joins a different queue to avoid conversation.

scenarios.title: The Public Sauna Turn
scenarios.intro: The changing room is full. The sauna is fuller. A handwritten list governs entry with greater force than statute.

terms.explanation: the steam and heat produced by throwing water on sauna stones.

scenarios.completion: The door opens. There is exactly enough bench for one reserved Finn.
scenarios.transition: Cool down on the way to the final office

events.message: A group leaves. You enter. This is the smoke sauna queue; your towel is registered for the other one.
Kari adds water to the stones. Conversation becomes physically impossible.
A tourist asks about swimwear etiquette. Seven people inspect the floor.
Three regulars depart at once, having completed an invisible schedule.

scenarios.title: The Migri Service Point
scenarios.intro: Your final appointment is to prove that you attended your final appointment. Your folder is blue. Everyone else's folder is also blue.

terms.explanation: clear, understood, or settled—depending on how brave you feel.

scenarios.completion: Your identity is confirmed. You receive a receipt confirming that confirmation may later be confirmed.

events.message: Your number appears. The clerk closes the desk for lunch beneath it. The number remains as a memorial.
A family has every document in the requested order. The queue experiences hope.
The booking system requests a booking reference for the booking system.
The security guard points to the correct desk before anyone asks. A minor national miracle.
